Is it a fiscal (or explicitly labelled) year?

is_fiscal_year.Rd

A year carrying an FY label, e.g. FY2019, FY19, FY 2020, or a crossover span FY2019-20 / FY2019/2020. Only the labelled form is detected: a bare four-digit year is intentionally excluded because it is indistinguishable by value from a count, an ID, or an ordinary integer.

Usage

is_fiscal_year(x)

Arguments

x

A character vector.

Value

Logical vector; TRUE for a labelled fiscal year.

See also

Other datetime detectors: is_abbr_month_date(), is_clock_time(), is_date(), is_date_range(), is_day_of_week(), is_hijri_date(), is_iso_date(), is_iso_datetime(), is_long_date(), is_month_day(), is_month_of_year(), is_month_year(), is_quarter(), is_rfc2822_datetime(), is_us_date(), is_us_datetime(), is_yyyymm()

Examples

is_fiscal_year(c("FY2019", "FY19", "FY2019-20", "2019", NA))
#> [1]  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE FALSE    NA
